svg.title: Driving · moving / exit unavailable
svg.desc: In-car layout over the unchanged S06 street still, not a speed measurement. No weapon or ammunition panel. Car marker replaces the local foot marker; health stays in place. Exit is offered only when authoritative stopped eligibility permits, not when the rounded speed happens to display zero. Concept mockup only; numbers, names and connection states are illustrative.

g.text: WEAPONS STOWED · NO FIRING IN CARS
